text.p: MobileMedia Corp, which filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection early on Thursday together with 18 affiliates, listed assets of $1.7 billion and liabilities of $1.3 billion, according to court documents.

The liabilities include fixed liquidated secured debt of $664.5 million with 50 holders; fixed liquidated unsecured debt of $676.9 million with more than 1000 holders; and 45.5 million shares of class A common stock.
MobileMedia's operating affiliate, MobileMedia Communications, operates the second largest paging company in the U.S.
According to court papers, at least 20 percent of the voting securities of MobileMedia are controlled by Hellman & Friedman Capital Partners II,LP.

Among the 20 largest unsecured creditors are State Street Bank & Trust, Boston, trustee for a $267.4 million claim; First Trust of NY, trustee for a $174.0 million claim; and Motorola Inc, with a $35.7 million claim. The nature of the claims is not noted in court papers.
The case has been assigned to U.S. Bankruptcy Court Judge Peter Walsh in Delaware.
